related.title: DDPM：前向加噪與訊噪比
related.titleEn: DDPM: forward noising and signal-to-noise ratio
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付計算樹、去重表與取樣變異報告。；17與25正確，唯一節點與實例分開，驗證label不進特徵。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver computation trees, deduplication tables and sampling-variance reports.; Counts match, unique nodes and instances are separated and validation labels never enter features.
related.difference: 列每步α與累積αbar兩欄，畫訊號與噪音兩支路；記錄噪音seed。；.9與.5正確，訊號與噪音平方係數和1，seed可重現。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate per-step alpha and cumulative alpha-bar, draw signal/noise branches and record the noise seed.; Results match, squared signal/noise coefficients sum1 and seeds reproduce outputs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無重複的兩跳展開最多1+s1+s1s2個節點實例；共享鄰居會減少唯一節點數。；教學一個seed，s1=4,s2=3；改s2=5。；N=1+4+4×3=17；改後1+4+4×5=25。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A disjoint two-hop expansion contains1+s1+s1s2 node instances; shared neighbors reduce unique nodes.; Teaching one seed,s1=4,s2=3, then s2=5.; N=1+4+4×3=17; changed N=25.
xt=√αbar x0+√(1−αbar)ε; cumulative αbar differs from per-step α.; Teaching x0=1.5,epsilon−.5,alpha-bar.64 then.36.; xt=.8×1.5+.6×(−.5)=.9; changed result=.5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Inception-v3：標籤平滑與機率質量
related.titleEn: Inception-v3: label smoothing and probability mass
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付計算樹、去重表與取樣變異報告。；17與25正確，唯一節點與實例分開，驗證label不進特徵。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver computation trees, deduplication tables and sampling-variance reports.; Counts match, unique nodes and instances are separated and validation labels never enter features.
related.difference: 列四類完整target：.925,.025,.025,.025，標明真類別索引與歸約方式。；.925與.85正確，四類機率和1且平滑只套一次。
related.differenceEn: List all four targets:.925,.025,.025,.025,with true-class index and reduction convention.; Values match,probability sums1 and smoothing is applied once.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無重複的兩跳展開最多1+s1+s1s2個節點實例；共享鄰居會減少唯一節點數。；教學一個seed，s1=4,s2=3；改s2=5。；N=1+4+4×3=17；改後1+4+4×5=25。
採均勻混合目標q=(1−ε)onehot+ε/K，真類別qtrue=1−ε+ε/K。；教學K4,ε.1；改ε.2，這不同於只向錯誤類別分配ε的慣例。；qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925；改後.85。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A disjoint two-hop expansion contains1+s1+s1s2 node instances; shared neighbors reduce unique nodes.; Teaching one seed,s1=4,s2=3, then s2=5.; N=1+4+4×3=17; changed N=25.

Uniform-mixed targets are q=(1−epsilon)onehot+epsilon/K, giving qtrue=1−epsilon+epsilon/K.; Teaching K4,epsilon.1 then.2; this differs from distributing epsilon only over incorrect classes.; qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925; changed result.85.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
